fix: Exact HS item-code search FieldError regression
root_cause: search_products() returns a queryset using select_related(category, material); calling only(public_id) on that queryset deferred a traversed relation and Django raised FieldError.
fix_details: Exact HS-code lookup now uses Product.objects with storefront status filtering.
values_list(public_id, flat=True) avoids loading unnecessary fields.
No user-controlled field names, raw SQL, or broadened visibility were introduced.
Exact lookup still redirects only AVAILABLE storefront products.
Added regression coverage for non-available product codes.
